name: Dead Reckoning Speeds Through Fireworks-Lit Street
description: Dead Reckoning moves quickly down a narrow side street as fireworks burst overhead. Bright flashes illuminate the night, reflecting off its polished steel body. The explosions light the urban surroundings in rapid succession, casting shifting colors and shadows as the vehicle presses forward without slowing.
related_events: Vehicle travels rapidly down side street amid fireworks display

name: Loading Ammo and Radioing the Boss
description: The guerillas carry boxes of ammunition and load them into a jeep. One of them picks up a radio and speaks into it: 'Guns and ammo, Boss. H A.'
related_events: Guerillas load ammunition boxes into a jeep
Guerilla reports gun and ammo status via radio

name: Cholo Wakes Foxy for Nighttime Truck Outing
description: In a dim, cluttered bedroom, Cholo rouses Foxy from sleep. Foxy jerks awake, blinking. Cholo tells him they're taking the truck out and to get the guys. Foxy starts to mention Riley, but Cholo cuts him off. He says not to include Riley, only the regular guys. Foxy nods, understanding.
related_events: Cholo wakes Foxy to announce truck outing
Cholo instructs Foxy to exclude Riley from outing

name: Riley and Mike Face the Advancing Undead
description: Riley and Mike stand on higher ground as three dead things lurch toward them from the town below. The figures move steadily, emerging from the shadows of ruined buildings and broken streets. Riley tenses, eyes fixed on the approaching forms. Mike grips his weapon, breath shallow. They do not speak, but both know the dead have sensed them—something in the air, the scent of blood, the presence of living flesh. The gap between them narrows.
related_events: Three dead things advance toward Riley and Mike
Riley and Mike recognize the threat

name: Big Daddy Notices Riley
description: Big Daddy replaces the nozzle on the gas pump. It pauses, sensing something, and looks up. Its dead eyes meet Riley's. Big Daddy grunts.
related_events: Big Daddy replaces gas pump nozzle and notices Riley

name: Riley and Mike Watch the Town
description: Riley Denbo stands watch, scanning the town through binoculars. Mike Converse looks on, uneasy, and speaks with urgency about the reanimated figures moving through the streets. He insists they are dead, not like them, and warns that something unnatural is happening.
related_events: Riley Denbo observes the town through binoculars
Mike Converse expresses fear about reanimated beings

name: Riley Sees Big Daddy and the Thing's Pain
description: Through the windshield, Riley spots Big Daddy and realizes it's the same person he saw at the gas station. At the same moment, he sees the anguish on the Thing's face, clear and raw, and understands it as something real and present.
related_events: Riley recognizes Big Daddy from the gas station
Riley recognizes the Thing's anguish

name: Cholo Meets Dead Reckoning at the Edge of Town
description: Dead Reckoning rolls to a stop on the edge of town as mortars launch fireworks into the sky, streaking light and noise across the area. At the same moment, Cholo pulls up on his motorcycle alongside the vehicle, the engine of his bike cutting through the bursts of sound from the explosions.
related_events: Cholo arrives on his bike alongside dead reckoning
Mortars fire fireworks during dead reckoning

name: Cholo and Team Board Vehicle and Face Approaching Threat
description: Cholo and his team quickly climb into the vehicle as the threat approaches. Inside, Foxy asks if they should launch 'sky flowers.' Cholo says no, adding that whatever is coming wants to get in—so they should let it in.
related_events: Cholo and his team scramble into the vehicle
Foxy suggests launching sky flowers
Cholo refuses to use sky flowers and allows entities to enter

name: Arrive at Tunnel Platform and Disembark
description: Cholo brings the cargo carrier to a halt on the tunnel platform. Foxy, Pretty Boy, Mouse, Anchor, and Scar leap off the flatbed as soon as the vehicle stops.
related_events: Cholo stops cargo carrier on tunnel platform
Foxy, Pretty Boy, Mouse, Anchor, and Scar jump off flatbed

name: Chihuahua retrieves Glock and hides magazine in its butt
description: The Chihuahua opens a filing cabinet and pulls out a Glock firearm. It then takes a magazine and shoves it forcefully into its own buttocks.
related_events: Chihuahua retrieves Glock from filing cabinet
Chihuahua inserts magazine into its butt

name: Sunrise Over a Forgotten City
description: The first light of dawn spreads across a triangle of land bordered by rivers, revealing a city in ruins. Once proud and vibrant, its buildings now stand cracked and silent, their windows dark. Seven bridges, each blocked and fortified, stretch across the waterways, connecting the city to the outside. A voice speaks, describing how the rivers once protected the city, how it was built as a marvel of human design, centered around a place called Fiddler's Green. The sun rises higher, casting long shadows over the empty streets and broken towers.
related_events: Sunrise illuminates decaying city surrounded by rivers
related_occasions: Narrated Overview Of The City'S Geographical And Structural Significance

name: Military Woman Destroys Walker at Electrified Fence
description: A Walker stumbles toward the barricade and reaches the electrified fencing. Upon contact, sparks erupt and its flesh begins to cook—boils form and burst, releasing smoke—but the creature does not fall. A soldier shouts a warning. The Military Woman raises her weapon and fires a burst of rounds into the Walker’s face. The creature’s head and upper body are torn apart, its remains left hanging, fused to the sparking barbs of the fence.
related_events: Walker contacts electrified fencing and is electrocuted
Military Woman shoots Walker in the face

name: Cholo and Workers Move Crate from Van
description: The doors of a beat-up white moving van swing open. Cholo reaches inside and pulls back an oilcloth covering a crate. He and the other workers tilt the crate onto a dolly. As they shift it, maggots become visible in a pool of blood beneath where the crate had been.
related_events: Cholo uncovers crate in moving van
Workers tip crate onto dolly
Maggots revealed beneath crate in pool of blood

name: Cholo, Mike, and Foxy Ride Out Together
description: Cholo and Mike ride down the road on Cholo's bike, heading toward the end of town. Foxy pulls up beside them on his own motorcycle and falls into step. The three move forward together, riding in formation. From somewhere off in the distance, Riley's voice calls out, "What the fuck?"
related_events: Cholo and Mike ride toward the end of town on Cholo's bike
Foxy joins Cholo and Mike on his motorcycle
Riley reacts with surprise to the group's movement

name: Gus and Barrett's Target Shooting Wager
description: Gus and Barrett stand outside the sales office of a fenced-in depot, once a car dealership, now filled with vehicles. Above them, an oversized inflatable advertising dummy in the shape of Tony Baloney flaps wildly in the air, its arms thrashing like a hula dancer. They raise their guns and fire. Bullets rip into the dummy’s face and neck. Barrett looks over, nods, and hands Gus a five-dollar bill.
related_events: Gus and Barrett shoot at targets outside the sales office
Bullets strike advertising dummy in the face and neck
Barrett hands Gus five dollars in acknowledgment of winning

name: Riley Quits Fiddler's Green
description: Riley and Charlie cross a manicured plaza toward the security checkpoint at the base of Fiddler's Green. Riley hands his ID to one of the two guards. The guard holds it up and says, "You're gonna need this." Riley shakes his head, steps past the checkpoint, and replies, "Nope. When I said quittin' time, I meant quittin' time." He continues walking without looking back.
related_events: Riley and Charlie approach security checkpoint at Fiddler's Green
Riley presents ID to security guard
Security guard returns Riley's ID with a warning
Riley declares he is quitting permanently

name: Cholo Shoots Reanimating Skeleton in Garbage Pit
description: Three heavily-armed guerillas heave a large crate over the edge of a precipice, sending it tumbling into a deep garbage pit below. The crate crashes among rubble and scattered human skeletons, most of them headless, their bones picked clean. Insects buzz in the thick air as rats scurry through the debris. One skeleton, partially buried, suddenly moves—a bony arm jerks upward from the pit. Cholo DeMora, a roguish young Latino, watches. Without hesitation, he reaches over his shoulder, unstraps a crossbow, and fires. The arrow streaks forward, piercing through the skull of the moving skeleton and exiting the other side.
related_events: Guerillas push crate over precipice into garbage pit
Skeletal remains in pit exhibit sudden movement
Cholo DeMora unstraps crossbow and shoots skeletal remains

name: Seize and Mark the First Dead Man
description: In the dim catacomb, a pole thrusts forward with a noose at its end. The loop slips around the neck of a Dead Man chained to the wall and pulls tight. Two men brace the pole while a third steps forward, spraying red paint across the Dead Man's face until it is fully marked.
related_events: Noose is launched and tightens around a captive Dead Man's neck
Third Man sprays red paint on the face of a Dead Thing

name: Drag and Mark the Second Dead Thing
description: Another Dead Thing is dragged into the catacomb. Two men hold a pole with a noose that snaps around the neck of a chained captive, tightening sharply. A third man sprays red paint onto the face of the first creature. Meanwhile, the second Dead Thing is doused in black paint as it lies on the ground.
related_events: Another Dead Thing is dragged into the catacomb and sprayed with black paint

name: Guerillas Extract Canned Food from Supermarket
description: A white moving van pulls up to a supermarket. In the parking lot, dead things stand near fireworks, mostly unmoving. Marksmen take positions around the lot, watching for threats. Guerillas move quickly from the van into the supermarket, emerging with cases of canned goods, which they load into the vehicle. One guerilla carries a hand-held radio. Riley's voice comes through, asking about the food. The guerilla responds, 'Lousy, but there's lots of it,' and continues loading the van.
related_events: White moving van arrives at supermarket
Marksmen provide cover in supermarket parking lot
Guerillas unload cases of canned goods from supermarket to van
Riley communicates with guerilla team via radio
Guerilla responds to Riley about food quality

name: Dead Teenagers Trigger Attendant's Routine at Abandoned Texaco
description: A dead teenage couple walks hand-in-hand near the rusted gas pumps of an abandoned Texaco station. The boy steps on the coiled hose that once signaled a car's arrival, and it lets out a faint, metallic ping. From inside the cracked glass doors of the station, an attendant emerges. His face is sunken and deeply lined, the left arm of his jumpsuit torn and stiff with dried blood. A faded 'TEXACO' patch and the name 'BIG DADDY' stitched above his chest mark his former role. He moves to the pump, removes the nozzle, and turns slowly, scanning the lot as if looking for a car to fuel. Finding none, he stands motionless, the hose dangling in his grip. Mike's voice comes from off-screen, quiet and low: 'It's like they're pretending to be alive.'
related_events: Dead teenage couple walks near defunct gas pumps
Boy steps on fuel hose trigger that emits a sound
Undead attendant emerges from station building
Undead attendant removes gas nozzle and searches for car
Mike observes undead beings mimicking life

name: Riley Coordinates with Guerilla Team Over Radio
description: PRETTY BOY drives while RILEY stands beside her, holding a radio. RILEY calls out to GUERILLA #2, asking for their location. A voice comes through the radio: they are at a drug store and offer aspirin. RILEY responds, requesting antibiotics instead. GUERILLA #2 confirms they are set. RILEY then calls for GUERILLA #3, trying to make contact.
related_events: RILEY communicates with GUERILLA #2 via radio
GUERILLA #2 reports location from drug store
RILEY requests antibiotics over radio
GUERILLA #2 confirms readiness over radio
RILEY attempts to contact GUERILLA #3 via radio

name: Cholo Fights Off Guards and Escapes
description: The security guards lead Cholo down the stairs. Cholo suddenly whirls around, slugs one guard, kicks another in the groin, and strikes the third in the face. He then runs through a fire door and escapes.
related_events: Cholo whirls and attacks the guards
Cholo slugs one guard
Cholo kicks guard in the groin
Cholo kicks third guard in the face

name: Cholo Escapes Through Fire Door
description: The security guards lead Cholo down the stairs. Cholo whirls around like a ninja, slugs one guard, kicks another in the groin, and strikes the third in the face. He then runs through a fire door and disappears.
related_events: Cholo escapes through a fire door

name: Arrival at the Liquor Store and Dispute Over Entering
description: Cholo screeches to a stop at a liquor store with Mike and Foxy. As they step out and approach the entrance, Dead Reckoning pulls up, and Riley and Charlie climb out. Charlie says there's nothing inside but booze, and that booze isn't essential. Foxy replies that a jug of good Kentucky whiskey goes for fifteen hundred back in town. Riley looks at Cholo and says he's not risking anybody's life just so Cholo can make some extra money. Cholo doesn't respond, and he and Foxy head into the store. Mike follows them. The doors are wide open, and only darkness is visible from the outside. Riley calls out, 'Mike! Wait!' but Mike continues inside.
related_events: Cholo screeches to a stop at a liquor store with Mike and Foxy
Dead Reckoning arrives and Riley and Charlie climb out
Charlie states that booze is not essential
Foxy mentions the high value of Kentucky whiskey
Riley refuses to risk lives for side money

name: Cholo, Foxy, and Mike Enter the Darkened Liquor Store
description: Cholo and Foxy step through the open doors of the liquor store, disappearing into the darkness inside. Mike follows close behind without hesitation. Behind them, Riley calls out, but they do not stop.
related_events: Cholo and Foxy begin entering the liquor store
Mike follows Cholo and Foxy into the liquor store

name: Riley and Charlie Find the Garage Empty
description: Riley and Charlie turn a corner and stop in front of a rundown garage with a tarp hanging in place of a door. Riley pulls the tarp aside and looks inside. A hobo lies asleep on the grease-stained floor, curled up under old newspapers. Riley asks where the car is. The hobo stirs and asks what car. Riley says it’s his new car—he paid for it and was there the day before, when two men were working on it. The hobo says no one was there that morning. Riley stands silent, his face dark. He whispers, 'Come on,' and turns away.
related_events: Riley and Charlie arrive at a rundown garage
Riley discovers a hobo sleeping inside the garage

name: Riley Confronts the Hobo About the Missing Car
description: Turning a corner, Riley and Charlie stop in front of a rundown garage with a tarp hanging down instead of a door. Riley pulls the tarp aside and looks inside. A hobo lies asleep on a grease-stained floor, curled under old newspapers. Riley steps in and asks where the car is. The hobo stirs, waking slowly, and asks what car. Riley says it's his new car—he paid for it and was there the day before, seeing two men working on it. The hobo sits up, saying no one was there that morning. Riley stands silent for a moment, his face dark. He whispers, 'Come on,' and turns away.
related_events: Riley confronts the absence of his new car
Hobo wakes up and denies knowledge of the car

name: Riley and Charlie Leave the Empty Garage
description: Riley turns the corner with Charlie and stops in front of a rundown garage with a tarp for a door. He pulls the tarp aside and looks inside. A hobo stirs on the grease-stained floor, waking up from under a pile of old newspapers. Riley asks where the car is. The hobo mumbles, asking what car. Riley insists it was his new car, that he paid for it, that two men were working on it the day before. The hobo says no one was there that morning. Riley stands still, his face dark. Charlie asks, 'What happened, Riley. Didja get fucked?' Riley doesn't answer. He whispers, 'Come on,' and turns away. Charlie follows as they walk off.
related_events: Charlie questions Riley about being cheated
Riley reacts with quiet fury and leaves

name: Big Daddy Warns the Frozen Dead
description: Fireworks burst in the sky, casting flickering light over Main Street, where the dead things stand frozen like statues, entranced. Big Daddy moves among them, weaving urgently between their stiff forms, waving his one good hand in sharp, frantic motions. A dead teenage cheerleader, R C, holds filthy pom-poms and watches him, uncomprehending. As Big Daddy continues to gesture, a spear suddenly pierces R C’s face, driven through by Harry, who roars past on a motorcycle, whooping like a cowhand. More bikers rumble down the street, guns firing. The cheerleader throws her head back and lets out a howl as she falls.
related_events: Fireworks mesmerize dead things on main street
Big Daddy warns siblings about fireworks danger
Dead teenage cheerleader fails to understand Big Daddy's warning

name: Harry Impales Cheerleader During Biker Attack
description: Fireworks burst overhead as DEAD THINGS stand frozen on main street. Big Daddy moves urgently among them, waving his good arm. Harry, a biker clad in battle gear, roars past on a motorcycle, thrusting a spear through the face of a dead teenage cheerleader. She throws her head back and emits a great howl before collapsing. Other bikers follow behind, speeding down the street as gunfire cracks through the air. Big Daddy watches the cheerleader fall.
related_events: Harry impales dead teenage cheerleader with a spear while riding a motorcycle
Dead teenage cheerleader lets out a great howl after being impaled
Big Daddy watches dead teenage cheerleader fall
Bikers fire guns while rumbling down main street

name: Unloading Supplies Under the Searchlight
description: Under the cover of darkness, guerillas unload supplies taken from Uniontown in a fenced outdoor yard. A searchlight sweeps across the area, casting moving beams over the activity. The train Dead Reckoning stands nearby, its steel frame venting hot steam. The men carry the stolen materials toward a set of rusty steel doors marked with a faded sign that reads 'Subway (To City)'. Harry, sweating and pale, helps with the unloading. Riley moves among the men, handing out bottles of beer.
related_events: Guerillas unload supplies taken from Uniontown
Searchlight scans the darkened yard during unloading operation
Harry assists in unloading while showing signs of illness
Riley distributes bottles of beer to the men

name: Riley Kills the Infected Harry
description: Riley approaches Harry and offers him a beer. Harry doesn't respond. When Riley calls his name again, Harry suddenly spins, growls, and lunges at Riley like a wild animal, grabbing him by the neck. Caught off guard, Riley smashes a beer bottle against the steel snout of Dead Reckoning and drives the jagged edge into Harry's forehead. Harry collapses to the ground, dead. Riley stands over the body, his expression a mix of anger and regret. Nearby, Pretty Boy says Harry must have been bitten after being knocked off his bike in town.
related_events: Harry attacks Riley in a violent outburst
Riley defends himself by impaling Harry with broken bottle
Riley reacts to Harry's death with anger and regret
Pretty Boy reports being knocked off his bike in town

name: The T-Bird Gun Run on Main Street
description: Riley and Mike stand behind the windshield, watching the T-Bird speed down Main Street with four guerillas inside. The guerillas laugh as they fire machine guns from the moving car, cutting down zombies in their path. Mike mutters that he expected a battle, but this is a massacre. Through an open hatch, Hollo calls out that these are the toughest guys in the neighborhood, and they won’t pass up a chance to have some fun. Riley shoots Cholo a sharp look, but Cholo insists he’s following orders. He tells Mike to come along, offering to show him the ropes. Mike climbs onto the back of Cholo’s motorcycle. Riley asks where they’re going. Cholo replies they’re going to get supplies—essential supplies—and adds that this is their job, isn’t it?
related_events: Four guerillas fire machine guns at zombies on Main Street
Mike comments on the situation as a massacre rather than a battle

name: Riley's Disapproval and Cholo's Defense
description: Riley gives Cholo an irritated look as the T-Bird roars down Main Street, its machine guns firing at zombies. Cholo, leaning out of the hatch, says to Mike, 'Hey, not me, Boss. You told me not to have any fun, I'm not having any fun at all.'
related_events: Riley gives Cholo an irritated look
Cholo claims he is not having fun as per Riley's orders

name: Cholo Takes Mike on a Supply Run
description: Cholo invites Mike to come along, telling him he'll show him the ropes. Mike climbs onto the back of Cholo's motorcycle. Riley calls out, asking where they're going. Cholo replies that they're going to get supplies—essential supplies—and says that’s their job, isn’t it?
related_events: Cholo invites Mike to come with him to learn the ropes
Cholo states their job is to get essential supplies
Riley questions Cholo about his destination

name: Cholo Passes Through the Checkpoint
description: Cholo approaches a checkpoint manned by two security guards. He sets down a bottle of champagne and a pack of Cohibas, then unstraps his weapons and hands them over. When asked, he says the boxes contain essential supplies for the man upstairs. The guard inspects the items, takes the weapons, and gives Cholo a claim check in return. Cholo picks up the boxes and steps onto the escalator, which carries him up into a vast atrium filled with sunlight, trees in planters, and caged birds chirping softly. Music plays overhead as shoppers walk past boutique stores and residents dine at outdoor cafes. Cholo pulls a kerchief from his pocket and wipes the smudges from his face.
related_events: Cholo approaches checkpoint guarded by two security guards
Cholo sets down champagne and Cohibas before inspection
Cholo unstraps and hands over his weapons
Cholo identifies himself and declares supplies for the man upstairs
Security guard questions contents of the boxes
Security guard accepts weapons and issues claim check

name: Cholo Enters the Atrium and Adjusts His Appearance
description: Cholo picked up his boxes and stepped onto the escalator, rising into a vast atrium bathed in sunlight streaming through glass walls. Trees in planters lined the space, their leaves catching the light, while caged birds chirped above the soft notes of Chopin playing through hidden speakers. Shoppers in fine clothes wandered past boutique stores, and residents dined at outdoor-style cafes. As he moved through the space, Cholo pulled a kerchief from his pocket and wiped the smudges from his face.
related_events: Cholo collects his boxes and ascends escalator into enormous atrium
Cholo wipes smudges off his face with kerchief to appear presentable

name: Cholo Halts Team, Redirects to Seize Truck
description: Cholo's team unstraps their weapons and prepares to fight as chaos erupts around them. Cholo stops them from engaging, then leads the group in a sprint across the lot toward the truck, Dead Reckoning.
related_events: Cholo's team prepares for battle by unstrapping weapons
Cholo stops his team from engaging in the fight
Cholo's team sprints across the lot to reach Dead Reckoning

name: Depot Guard Reacts to Screams
description: The depot guard hears screams echoing through the lot. He turns and sprints toward his men, leaving his post behind.
related_events: Depot guard runs toward his men after hearing screams

name: Gunner Opens Fire on Walkers at Machine-Gun Battery
description: A gunner at the machine-gun battery opens fire on the approaching walkers. Bullets rip through the air, many striking and sparking against the wire fencing as the undead press forward.
related_events: Gunner opens fire on walkers with a machine-gun battery

name: Cholo Arrives and Knipp Answers with Scissors
description: Cholo steps out of the elevator carrying champagne and Cohibas. He walks to Penthouse Number One and rings the bell. The door is suddenly yanked open by Tyler Knipp, who stands there with scissors in hand, his expression frightened. When he sees Cholo, he lowers the scissors. He says Mister Kaufman isn't home and that something bad is happening. A scream rings out from down the corridor.
related_events: Cholo exits elevator carrying champagne and Cohibas
Cholo rings bell at Penthouse Number One
Tyler Knipp abruptly opens door wielding scissors
Tyler Knipp lowers scissors upon recognizing Cholo
Tyler Knipp reports Mister Kaufman is absent and trouble is occurring
Scream echoes from down the corridor

name: Cholo Breaks Into Penthouse Two After Hearing Screams
description: Cholo drops the boxes he is carrying and runs down the corridor toward Penthouse Number Two. The door is locked. He throws himself against it, the latch splinters, and the door bursts open.
related_events: Cholo drops boxes and rushes down the corridor
Cholo attempts to enter Penthouse Number Two but finds the door locked
Cholo breaks through the locked door of Penthouse Number Two

name: The Gazebo in Uniontown Park
description: A full moon casts pale light over a quiet American town. The streets are dark—no lamps, no lights in windows, no glow from shop signs. Silhouetted figures move slowly along the sidewalks, passing storefronts that advertise Reliable Appliances, Well-Made Clothes, Solid Values. A diner’s neon sign promises the BEST EATS IN TOWN, but the letters are dead. From Uniontown Park comes a sound: TCHICK! KA-TCHICK-TCHICK. Inside the park, three figures stand in the gazebo—one shaking a tambourine in uneven bursts, another fumbling with a trombone, the third with a saxophone that emits no tune. The other townspeople drift aimlessly nearby. As the eye adjusts, the truth becomes clear: the musicians are not alive. Flesh hangs from their bones, their eyes are hollow. The same decay marks the pedestrians. The town, once pristine in appearance, shows cracks in the pavement, peeling paint, rot in the wood. The music does not start. The lights do not come on.
related_events: Power outage leaves entire town in darkness
Tambourine player produces erratic rhythmic noise
Musicians fail to play instruments properly at gazebo
Closer inspection reveals musicians and pedestrians are dead with rotting flesh
Town's illusion of perfection collapses as decay becomes visible
related_occasions: Gathering In Uniontown Park

name: Mike and Riley Watch the Undead Imitate the Living
description: A full moon casts pale light over the quiet town. Mike and Riley stand unseen, their voices low. Below, figures move slowly through Uniontown Park, drawn to a gazebo where three musicians fumble with instruments. The trombone wheezes, the saxophone squeaks, but the tambourine rattles in uneven bursts—TCHICK! KA-TCHICK-TCHICKY-TCHICK. The musicians do not respond to the sounds they make. Their skin hangs loose, bones peeking through. Others wander nearby, silhouetted against the darkened shops, their steps slow and aimless. The neon sign of the diner flickers but does not light. No windows glow. The town is still, rotting. Mike speaks. They're trying to be us. Riley answers. They used to be us.
related_events: Mike and Riley observe that the creatures are imitations of themselves
related_occasions: Gathering In Uniontown Park

name: Cholo and His Team Exit the Subway and Are Confronted by a Depot Guard
description: The steel doors beneath the 'SUBWAY' sign slide open, and Cholo steps out, followed by his team. As the doors close and lock behind them, a depot guard moves forward, blocking their path. 'What's up, Cholo?' the guard asks. Cholo pulls out a paper and says, 'Takin' the truck out.' The guard frowns. 'You just got back in this morning.' Cholo remains calm. 'Nobody gets a day off these days.' The guard takes the paper. 'Hey, wait a minute—this is from yesterday.' Cholo doesn't flinch. 'Oh, I must have given you the wrong one. Here...' He reaches down, not into his pocket, but toward his gun. Suddenly, shots ring out. Cholo pauses. 'What's that?' The guard doesn't move. 'Relax. Just target practise.'
related_events: Cholo and his team exit subway through steel doors
Depot guard confronts Cholo upon arrival

name: Cholo shows a paper to the guard, who notices it is outdated
description: Cholo steps forward and hands an official-looking paper to the depot guard, who takes it and examines the date. The guard points out that the document is from yesterday. Cholo remains calm and says he must have given the wrong one, then reaches down.
related_events: Cholo presents official-looking paper to depot guard
Depot guard notices paper is dated from yesterday

name: Cholo Reaches for Gun as Gunshots Ring Out
description: The steel doors under the 'SUBWAY' sign close and lock behind Cholo and his team. A Depot Guard steps forward, questioning Cholo about taking the truck out again so soon. Cholo hands over a paper, then realizes it's outdated. He says he must have given the wrong one and reaches down—not for another document, but toward his waistband. Before he can draw his gun, shots ring out nearby. Cholo pauses, startled. The Depot Guard says calmly, 'Relax. Just target practise.'
related_events: Cholo attempts to draw gun from waistband

name: Depot Guard Explains Gunshots as Target Practice
description: The steel doors under the 'SUBWAY' sign slide shut behind Cholo and his team. A depot guard steps forward, glancing at the paper Cholo hands him. As the guard points out the date, Cholo reaches down. Suddenly, gunshots ring out. Cholo flinches, hand pausing. The guard doesn't react strongly, saying it's just target practice.
related_events: Depot guard dismisses gunshots as target practice

name: Harry Charges the Fireworks-Distracted Walker
description: Harry speeds toward a walker on his motorcycle. The walker stands still, staring at the fireworks lighting up the sky. Harry aims straight for it, closing in fast.
related_events: Harry makes a run toward a walker distracted by fireworks

name: Dead Woman Strikes Harry with a Bat
description: Harry rides toward a Walker standing still in the glow of fireworks. Before he can reach it, the Dead Woman swings a baseball bat and hits him hard. Harry is thrown from his motorcycle, which skids sideways and crashes into a building. He struggles to get up as two Dead Things close in. Another motorcycle roars up, driven by Anchor, who calls out for Harry to jump on. Harry fights off the attackers, climbs onto the back of Anchor's bike, and they speed away.
related_events: Dead Woman hits Harry with a baseball bat

name: Harry's Crash and the Ambush by the Dead
description: Harry's motorcycle fishtails out of control and slams into the side of a building. Dazed, he tries to get up, but two dead things close in and attack. He fights them off just as another motorcycle roars up, driven by Anchor, who calls for Harry to jump on. Harry breaks free, leaps onto the bike, and they speed away.
related_events: Harry's motorcycle loses control and crashes into a building
Harry attempts to rise while being attacked by two dead things

name: Anchor Rescues Harry from the Dead Things
description: As Harry struggles on the ground, two Dead Things close in. A motorcycle rumbles up the street. Anchor, built like Popeye, shouts, "Harry, jump on!" Harry kicks free from the attackers, scrambles to his feet, and leaps onto the bike. The engine roars as they speed away, leaving the Dead Things behind. Harry's own motorcycle lies crumpled against the side of a building, smoke curling from its frame.
related_events: Anchor arrives on a motorcycle and rescues Harry
Harry fights off the dead things and boards Anchor's motorcycle
Harry and Anchor speed away from the scene

name: Riley Questions Mike's Shooting Ability
description: Riley looks at Mike's guns and asks if he knows how to use them. Mike replies that it's his first time out and he's never had to fire them before. Riley mutters under his breath that he's stuck out there with someone who can't shoot, then tells Mike to get moving.
related_events: Riley questions Mike about his shooting ability
Mike admits he has never used his guns before

name: Mike Attacked by Clown Zombie

Slack says it wasn’t the little man who ordered it—it was the big man, the one who controls everything in the underground: drugs, sex, gambling. He keeps people distracted so they don’t question why he lives well while others starve. Riley presses: why target Slack? Slack replies they found out he was working with Mulligan, tired of scraping by on scraps. Riley says every place is the same, but he’s done. He’s going north—Canada—somewhere with no people. Slack asks to come with him. Charlie says Riley won’t take anyone, that he likes being alone, though he might take Charlie since having him around is almost the same as being by himself. Charlie adds that he can be useful and that he can shoot. Slack counters that he can shoot too, and that he had training, that he was going to join the Army before they forced him into prostitution instead. Riley cuts him off, saying he doesn’t want to hear anyone’s story, that he’s tired of them all. Slack turns it back on him: what’s Riley’s story? They lock eyes. Riley says he doesn’t have one—his father was a preacher, his mother kept the house, he went to school, studied engineering. Nothing bad ever happened to him—until everything changed. Slack replies that everything changed for all of them, stories or not. A sound outside catches their attention. Charlie looks out the window. Four security men are chasing Mulligan into the alley. They drive him against a wall, beat him with clubs, and drag him away. Riley reaches instinctively through the bars, but can’t intervene. Charlie asks what they’ll do—will they kill him? Slack says not yet. First, they’ll try to get information from him—about people like Slack. Riley places a hand on Slack’s back.

name: Riley and Charlie Walk Through the Ghetto
description: Riley and Charlie walk down a street into the city's ghetto zone, a rowdy stretch lined with taverns, gambling clubs, and strip joints, buzzing with the energy of an Alaskan gold-rush boom town. Buyers and sellers linger in the shadows, trading goods, copulating, dealing drugs. As Riley passes, people recognize him, calling out or nodding in greeting. He smiles back, hands a few bills to a father holding a young son, and pats an old man on the back. Charlie asks if they can stop for a drink, but Riley declines, saying they need to see a man about a car. Without pause, Riley turns into an alley, Charlie following close behind.

Riley exchanges greetings with locals in the ghetto

name: Riley and Charlie Enter the Alley
description: Riley and Charlie walk deeper into the district. Charlie asks if they can stop for a drink, saying he could use one, but Riley declines and keeps moving. He leads Charlie off the main street and into a narrow alley. The sounds of the crowded district fade slightly as they step into the dimmer space, where a small group has gathered around a man standing on a soapbox. The man, Mulligan, speaks with intensity, addressing the onlookers in a thick Irish accent. He holds a whiskey bottle in one hand and gestures sharply with the other, calling for resistance against the ruling power. Riley and Charlie come to a stop, watching as the man takes a swig and continues his speech.
related_events: Charlie requests a drink but Riley refuses
Riley and Charlie turn into an alley and encounter revolutionaries

name: Riley and Charlie Encounter Mulligan's Rally
description: Riley and Charlie enter an alley where Mulligan stands on a soapbox, addressing a small crowd with a passionate speech in an Irish accent. He calls for rebellion against the ruling force, gesturing toward the distant Fiddler's Green high-rise. Taking a swig from a whiskey bottle, he offers it to Riley as he speaks. Riley interrupts, saying the ghetto can't be fixed—only escaped. Mulligan argues that with Riley’s network, their movement would have the strength to succeed. He presses the bottle into Riley’s hand. Riley passes it to Charlie, who drinks. As the exchange unfolds, a boy’s cough is heard. Mulligan turns to see his son Brian standing behind him, pale and unwell. The boy insists he’s fine. Riley begins to walk away, then pauses. Without a word, he reaches into his pocket and places a small bottle of antibiotics in Mulligan’s hand. Mulligan looks down, then up again, but Riley and Charlie are already gone.

name: Riley Gives Antibiotics and Leaves
description: Mulligan's son Brian coughs, drawing attention to his feverish state. Mulligan turns to check on him, and the boy insists he is fine. Riley, already moving away, pauses, reaches into his pocket, and silently places a small bottle of antibiotics into Mulligan's hand. Without a word, Riley turns and walks off with Charlie, the two of them disappearing into the shadows of the alley, leaving the group behind.

name: Charlie Drinks the Whiskey
description: Mulligan offered the whiskey bottle to Riley, who declined but passed it to Charlie. Charlie took the bottle and drank from it, then handed it back. The alley was quiet for a moment, the crowd still gathered, the air thick with smoke and the distant hum of the city.

name: Riley, Charlie, and Mike Exit Dead Reckoning
description: Riley, Charlie, and Mike step out of the war wagon Dead Reckoning, a massive vehicle built from scavenged parts and covered in riveted steel. Gatling guns extend from its front, and twin fourteen-inch cannons sit atop a roof turret. Mortar tubes on the roof fire fireworks into the night sky, bursting in bright flares. Charlie looks up, calling them 'flowers in the graveyard,' and asks Riley why he calls them that. Riley replies that these are sky flowers, not the kind laid on the ground, and tells Charlie he loves him for still believing in heaven. The White Moving Van arrives and parks beside them. Cholo jumps out with three guerrillas from the dump and asks if they’ve checked the town. Riley says it looks untouched. Around them, the fireworks continue to launch, glowing high above.

description: A white moving van rolls in and parks beside the war wagon Dead Reckoning. Cholo jumps out, followed by three guerrillas. Four guerrillas climb into an old T-Bird convertible mounted with machine guns. Two other armed men take positions on motorcycles. One by one, engines roar to life. The sound builds into a deep growl that fills the night as the vehicles prepare to move out.

name: Cholo and Charlie's Final Exchange Before Departure
description: Cholo asked if everyone was ready. Charlie responded with a grin, saying he was always ready, and gestured to his four holstered sidearms, two shouldered automatic rifles, and the Remington he carried. Cholo called him an idiot. Charlie leaned in, smiling slyly, and asked if Cholo didn’t also see the iron. Cholo revved his motorcycle engine, shouted, and sped off toward town. Charlie stayed behind for a moment, then climbed back into the war wagon.

name: Cholo's Last Ride
description: Cholo grinned and said it was time to have some fun. Riley cut in, reminding everyone the mission was about getting in, doing the job, and getting out alive—no mistakes. Cholo replied that it was his last day too. Riley looked surprised. Without another word, Cholo climbed onto his motorcycle, revved the engine, and roared off toward town, yelling, 'YEEEE-HAAAAAAAA!' as he disappeared into the night.

name: Mike Questions the Sky Flowers
description: The T-Bird and motorcycles roar toward town, engines fading into the distance. Riley and Charlie turn back to Dead Reckoning, moving toward the war wagon. Mike lingers for a moment, eyes lifted to the fireworks still bursting in the sky. 'Do those things really work?' he asks. Riley watches the streaks of light above. 'Yup,' he says. 'Stenches can't take their eyes off `em.' His voice carries a quiet heaviness as he turns away.

name: Cholo Retrieves Dom Perignon and Fights Off Zombie
description: Cholo spots a case of Dom Perignon inside a dusty refrigerated unit. He unstraps his crossbow, opens the door, and reaches in to grab the case. As he pulls it toward him, a third hand suddenly clamps down on the box. Cholo looks up just as a dead figure steps through the back of the unit, its forehead marked with a swastika tattoo. The creature growls and lunges, knocking Cholo down and pinning him beneath its weight. They struggle on the floor, the case of champagne between them, as the zombie snaps its teeth toward Cholo’s face. Cholo punches it, but the creature keeps coming. Then a single gunshot rings out—the zombie collapses, dead. Cholo pushes the body aside, grabs the champagne, and stands back up.

Zombie emerges from loading area and attacks Cholo

name: Charlie's Shot, Mike's End
description: Cholo struggles with a zombie that emerges from behind a broken refrigerator unit, its swastika-marked forehead looming as it attacks. Foxy fires a shot but misses. Charlie draws his weapon and fires a single round into the center of the zombie’s forehead, dropping it instantly. Mike says, "Nice shootin'." Charlie replies, "Good shootin'. Ain't no such thing as nice shootin'." As the group begins to move out, a second zombie, a dead police officer with half its face gone, lunges from behind stacked cartons and bites Mike in the leg. Mike screams, staggering back. Riley and Charlie spin around at the sound. Cholo fires an arrow from his crossbow into the second zombie’s head. Mike, trembling, presses the barrel of his .45 under his chin and pulls the trigger, shooting himself. Riley kneels beside the body, holding the dead man as he slumps to the floor.

'Close one,' Riley says. Cholo looks around, then walks back to the fallen case of Dom Perignon, picks it up, and holds it tightly.

Mike screams, stumbles into a wall, and collapses to the floor. Riley and Charlie spin around at the sound. Cholo, standing closest, draws his crossbow and fires an arrow through the zombie's head. The creature crumples. Cholo tucks the crossbow away.

name: Mike's Last Moments Before His Suicide
description: After being bitten by a dead policeman, Mike collapses against the wall, clutching his wounded leg. He looks up at Riley, his voice trembling as he says he is already dead. Riley kneels beside him, gripping his shoulder and telling him it will be alright. Mike shakes his head, then suddenly raises his .45, places the barrel under his chin, and fires. The shot echoes through the store. Riley freezes, stunned, his arm still outstretched. Mike’s body slumps to the floor, eyes wide open, unseeing.

name: Cholo Takes Cigars and Flees with Foxy

related_events: Cholo takes box of Cohibas and flees store with Foxy

name: Riley Stares at Mike's Lifeless Eyes After His Suicide
description: After Mike fires the shot, the blast echoes through the store. Riley stands frozen, his arms still partially supporting the body. Slowly, he lowers Mike to the floor, the weight sinking heavily. He crouches beside him, one hand resting on the corpse as he stares into Mike's open, unseeing eyes. The silence presses in, broken only by distant creaks. Riley does not move, his face etched with shock, his breath shallow. The others have fled. Only he remains, kneeling in the dim light, watching the lifeless face of the young man who chose death over transformation.
related_events: Riley reacts to Mike's suicide with shock and devastation

name: Cholo Enters the Apartment and Finds a Hanging Man
description: Cholo steps into a dark foyer, the only light spilling from a room deeper inside. A soft, rhythmic squeak echoes through the space, like a child's swing swaying back and forth. He moves forward cautiously, eyes straining in the dimness. As he turns a corner, the light grows brighter and the sound louder. In the kitchen, a middle-aged man hangs lifeless from a homemade noose tied to a light fixture. The body sways slowly, face pale under the harsh glow. A chair lies toppled on the floor beneath him. Cholo freezes, staring at the scene.

Cholo discovers hanging body of middle-aged man in kitchen

name: Hysterical Woman Confronts Cholo After Suicide Discovery
description: Cholo discovers a man hanging from a noose in the kitchen, his body swaying under the harsh light. Before he can react, a middle-aged woman grabs him from behind, her voice frantic and broken with sobs. She cries out that her Johnny has killed himself, repeating the words in anguish. She pleads for help, then demands to know who Cholo is when he says he’s not security. Her hysteria mounts as she resumes screaming, filling the apartment with noise just as a young man steps into the kitchen and begins cutting the body down.

The hanged man’s eyes snap open, blinking rapidly, and his body twitches. Without warning, he turns and lunges at the young man. The sudden movement strains the light fixture overhead, which sparks violently and tears from the ceiling, crashing to the floor. The hanged man and the young man fall with it, disappearing into the dark. The apartment is plunged into blackness.

Cholo rushed to the fireplace, grabbed a poker and a matchlight, and lit the way into the kitchen. The woman screamed again from the doorway. Cholo pulled the poker free and listened. Shuffling sounds came from the far end of the kitchen.

He moves across the kitchen, matchlight in hand, the flame casting flickering shadows as he follows the noise. The shuffling grows louder. name: Riley and Charlie Enter the Cage Arena
description: Riley and Charlie step into a large, crowded room buzzing with spectators packed onto tiered wooden stands. At the center, an iron-mesh cage stands surrounded by onlookers shouting and waving cash. The gates of the cage swing open, and the Painted Walkers—Dead Red and Dead Black—are shoved inside. Their nooses are cut loose, and the gates clang shut behind them. Dead Red reaches out and touches the paint on Dead Black’s face, fingers coming away streaked with black. Dead Black does the same, smearing red onto its hands, then licks its palm and spits, recoiling at the taste. Around the cage, bookies move through the crowd, grabbing wads of cash from bettors. Riley watches silently. Charlie asks what the betting is for. Riley says it’s Red or Black—whichever one wins the fight. A tout nearby adds, 'They do when there's food.' Another gate in the cage opens. A hush falls. A woman stumbles in—alive, bruised, dressed in torn fabric. Her name was Slack. Now she presses herself against the cage wall as the two Painted Walkers turn toward her and begin to advance.

Seizing the moment, Slack darts to the edge of the cage and begins climbing the iron mesh. She ascends quickly, reaching nearly to the top, but the cage shakes as Dead Red hurls Dead Black against the wall. Dead Black recovers, lunges, and seizes Slack by the ankle, yanking her down. She crashes to the ground, the impact echoing as Dead Black looms over her.

Dead Red lunged at Slack, but Riley cut it down with another burst. The crowd erupted in panic, surging toward the exits as gunfire cracked through the air. name: Riley and Charlie Stop Chihuahua's Rampage
description: Chihuahua shoved through the panicked crowd, his suit torn and bloodied, and leveled his Glock at Charlie. Before he could fire, Riley opened fire with the M-16, striking Chihuahua in the stomach. The bullet meant for Charlie missed. Wounded, Chihuahua snarled, cursing the damage to his suit, and turned his gun toward Riley, firing as he advanced. Slack kicked hard against the iron mesh, shaking the cage just enough to knock Riley aside. The bullet meant for Riley struck her instead. Chihuahua kept shooting, staggering forward despite his injury. Charlie raised his weapon and fired a single shot into Chihuahua's skull. Chihuahua collapsed, the gunfire ceased, and the cage fell silent except for the echoes of the shots.

name: Riley Rescues Slack and Is Arrested by Police
description: Riley spots Chihuahua's two armed goons in the crowd just as four policemen burst into the arena, halting the chaos. He rushes to the cage, blasts the lock open with his rifle, and runs inside. On the floor lies Slack, motionless. He kneels beside her, thinking she's dead, but she stirs, reassuring him she's alive. She lifts her right arm, revealing a bleeding gunshot wound. They exchange a brief look, a flicker of recognition passing between them. A policeman approaches and demands to know what happened. Riley points toward the crowd and says someone shot 'the little fat man.' Without hesitation, the officer places Riley under arrest. Other officers begin securing the scene as Slack is attended to, the cage still echoing with the aftermath of violence.
